name: quickfile
description: Quickfile, a web-based Barangay Document Request and Management System designed to digitalize the process of requesting barangay documents. It allows citizens to submit requests online while enabling barangay personnel to process requests, prepare and print documents, and manage records efficiently. The system also features centralized document records and archiving, QR-based document verification, and automated transaction reports to improve record retrieval, document authenticity checking, and administrative monitoring.
author: Rick Warren Nicasio, Jay Kyle Tañdo, Emmge Ramos, Khem Shwartz Cabutad
